title: Examination of Conscience for Children
description: A simple and child-friendly examination to help children prepare for confession, using language and examples they can understand.
source: Adapted from Traditional Catholic Teaching for Children

categories.title: My Relationship with God
categories.description: How I have shown love to God through prayer and worship.

items.text: Did I remember to pray to God each day?
items.clarification: God loves to hear from you every day, even if it's just a short prayer.

items.text: Did I pay attention during Mass, or was I distracting others?
Did I miss Sunday Mass without a good reason?
Did I use God's name or Jesus' name without respect?
Did I show respect in church by genuflecting, being quiet, and participating?
Did I forget to thank God for the good things in my life?

categories.title: My Relationship with Parents and Family
categories.description: How I have shown love and respect to my parents, brothers, and sisters.

items.text: Did I disobey my parents or teachers?
items.clarification: Even when it's hard, obeying your parents shows love for them and for God.

items.text: Did I talk back to my parents or speak to them disrespectfully?
Did I help with chores when asked?
Did I fight with my brothers or sisters?
Did I share my toys and things with others in my family?
Did I tell the truth to my parents and teachers?
Did I do my best to help when someone in my family was sad or needed help?

categories.title: My Relationship with Friends and Others
categories.description: How I have treated my friends and other people.

items.text: Did I say unkind things to anyone or call them mean names?
items.clarification: Our words can hurt others just like actions can.

items.text: Did I refuse to play with someone or leave them out on purpose?
Did I share with others and take turns?
Did I say things about others that weren't true or that made them look bad?
Did I cheat in games or schoolwork?
Did I fight with others or try to get even when someone hurt me?
Did I help someone who was hurt or needed help?
Did I tell lies to keep myself out of trouble or to get what I wanted?

categories.title: Taking Care of Myself
categories.description: How I have taken care of the gifts God has given me.

items.text: Did I take care of my body by eating healthy foods, getting enough sleep, and being active?
items.clarification: God gave you your body as a gift, and He wants you to take good care of it.

items.text: Did I try my best at school and with my homework?
Was I lazy about helping or doing my chores?
Did I spend too much time playing video games or watching TV?
Did I waste food or things that others could use?
Did I break things on purpose or treat my belongings carelessly?

categories.title: Showing Respect for Things
categories.description: How I have taken care of things that belong to me and others.

items.text: Did I take something that didn't belong to me?
items.clarification: Taking things without permission is stealing, even if it's small.

items.text: Did I return things I borrowed?
Did I take care of books, toys, and other things that belong to others?
Did I treat holy things (like rosaries, Bibles, or things in church) with respect?
Did I help keep our home, school, and church clean and neat?

categories.title: Being Honest and Truthful
categories.description: How I have been truthful in what I say and do.

items.text: Did I tell lies or hide the truth?
items.clarification: God wants us to be truthful even when it's difficult.

items.text: Did I make promises I didn't keep?
Did I blame others for things I did wrong?
Did I cheat on tests or in games?
Did I tell the truth even when it was hard?

categories.title: Being Kind and Loving
categories.description: How I have shown God's love to others through kindness.

items.text: Did I say 'please' and 'thank you' to others?
items.clarification: Being polite is one way we show respect and kindness.

items.text: Did I help someone who was sad or hurt?
Did I share with others who have less than I do?
Did I say 'I'm sorry' when I hurt someone?
Did I include others who were alone or left out?
Did I make fun of others because they're different from me?
Did I forgive others when they said they were sorry?
